name: TASKBAR & START ACCENT TINT
description: Applies the accent color to the taskbar, Start menu and Action Center (Windows Settings: 'Show accent color on Start, taskbar and action center').
check: powershell -NoProfile -Command "try { $v = (Get-ItemProperty -Path 'HKCU:\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Themes\Personalize' -Name 'ColorPrevalence' -ErrorAction Stop).ColorPrevalence; if ($v -eq 1) { exit 0 } else { exit 1 } } catch { exit 1 }"

name: DWM ACCENT MIRROR FLAG
description: Mirrors the tint flag into the DWM branch (DWM\ColorPrevalence) - some apps and the lock screen read this copy instead.
check: powershell -NoProfile -Command "try { $v = (Get-ItemProperty -Path 'HKCU:\Software\Microsoft\Windows\DWM' -Name 'ColorPrevalence' -ErrorAction Stop).ColorPrevalence; if ($v -eq 1) { exit 0 } else { exit 1 } } catch { exit 1 }"

name: ACCENT COLOR: WINDOWS BLUE
description: Stock Windows blue (#0078D7). Restores the exact factory accent values, including the native 8-slot Start palette.
check: powershell -NoProfile -Command "try { $v = (Get-ItemProperty -Path 'HKCU:\Software\Microsoft\Windows\DWM' -Name 'AccentColor' -ErrorAction Stop).AccentColor; if (('{0:X8}' -f ([int64]$v -band 4294967295)) -eq 'FFD77800') { exit 0 } else { exit 1 } } catch { exit 1 }"

name: ACCENT COLOR: TEAL

name: SMALL TASKBAR BUTTONS
description: Uses small icons on the taskbar (Windows needs an Explorer restart to re-layout, which this row does automatically).
check: powershell -NoProfile -Command "try { $v = (Get-ItemProperty -Path 'HKCU:\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Explorer\Advanced' -Name 'TaskbarSmallIcons' -ErrorAction Stop).TaskbarSmallIcons; if ($v -eq 1) { exit 0 } else { exit 1 } } catch { exit 1 }"

name: TASKBAR: NEVER COMBINE BUTTONS
description: Forces each window to get its own taskbar button (TaskbarGlomLevel = 2). OFF returns to 'always combine'.
check: powershell -NoProfile -Command "try { $v = (Get-ItemProperty -Path 'HKCU:\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Explorer\Advanced' -Name 'TaskbarGlomLevel' -ErrorAction Stop).TaskbarGlomLevel; if ($v -eq 2) { exit 0 } else { exit 1 } } catch { exit 1 }"

name: CLOCK WITH SECONDS
description: Shows seconds in the taskbar clock. Applies immediately - no restart needed.
check: powershell -NoProfile -Command "try { $v = (Get-ItemProperty -Path 'HKCU:\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Explorer\Advanced' -Name 'ShowSecondsInSystemClock' -ErrorAction Stop).ShowSecondsInSystemClock; if ($v -eq 1) { exit 0 } else { exit 1 } } catch { exit 1 }"

name: TRAY: ALWAYS SHOW ALL ICONS
description: Keeps every notification-area icon visible instead of hiding new ones behind the overflow arrow (EnableAutoTray = 0).
check: powershell -NoProfile -Command "try { $v = (Get-ItemProperty -Path 'HKCU:\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Explorer' -Name 'EnableAutoTray' -ErrorAction Stop).EnableAutoTray; if ($v -eq 0) { exit 0 } else { exit 1 } } catch { exit 1 }"

name: START: RECENTLY OPENED ITEMS
description: Shows recently opened items in Start and on the taskbar jump lists (Start_TrackDocs = 1, Windows default).
check: powershell -NoProfile -Command "try { $v = (Get-ItemProperty -Path 'HKCU:\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Explorer\Advanced' -Name 'Start_TrackDocs' -ErrorAction Stop).Start_TrackDocs; if ($v -eq 0) { exit 1 } else { exit 0 } } catch { exit 0 }"

name: START: MOST USED APPS
description: Shows your most frequently used apps at the top of the app list (Start_TrackProgs = 1). Turn OFF for a cleaner, static Start.
check: powershell -NoProfile -Command "try { $v = (Get-ItemProperty -Path 'HKCU:\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Explorer\Advanced' -Name 'Start_TrackProgs' -ErrorAction Stop).Start_TrackProgs; if ($v -eq 0) { exit 1 } else { exit 0 } } catch { exit 0 }"

name: DESKTOP ICON: THIS PC
description: Shows (ON) or hides (OFF) the 'This PC' icon on the desktop. Applies immediately.
check: powershell -NoProfile -Command "try { $v = (Get-ItemProperty -Path 'HKCU:\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Explorer\HideDesktopIcons\NewStartPanel' -Name '{20D04FE0-3AEA-1069-A2D8-08002B30309D}' -ErrorAction Stop).'{20D04FE0-3AEA-1069-A2D8-08002B30309D}'; if ($v -eq 1) { exit 1 } else { exit 0 } } catch { exit 0 }"

name: DESKTOP ICON: RECYCLE BIN
description: Shows (ON) or hides (OFF) the Recycle Bin icon on the desktop. Applies immediately.
check: powershell -NoProfile -Command "try { $v = (Get-ItemProperty -Path 'HKCU:\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Explorer\HideDesktopIcons\NewStartPanel' -Name '{645FF040-5081-101B-9F08-00AA002F954E}' -ErrorAction Stop).'{645FF040-5081-101B-9F08-00AA002F954E}'; if ($v -eq 1) { exit 1 } else { exit 0 } } catch { exit 0 }"

name: DESKTOP ICON: USER'S FILES
description: Shows (ON) or hides (OFF) the hidden 'User's Files' virtual folder icon on the desktop. Applies immediately.
check: powershell -NoProfile -Command "try { $v = (Get-ItemProperty -Path 'HKCU:\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Explorer\HideDesktopIcons\NewStartPanel' -Name '{59031a47-3f72-44a7-89c5-5595fe6b30ee}' -ErrorAction Stop).'{59031a47-3f72-44a7-89c5-5595fe6b30ee}'; if ($v -eq 1) { exit 1 } else { exit 0 } } catch { exit 0 }"
